{{Top|leg}}
A '''slug cannon''' was a weapon that could be mounted on [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]]s. It fired [[Slug/Legends|slugs]], and was generally used when K-wings were configured as penetrators, and carried no energy weapons.
